description: Find flight itineraries and fares. Not booking or hotels: use google_search for hotel pages. Required: departure_id, arrival_id, outbound_date.

adults.description: Adult passenger count, positive integer; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

arrival_id.description: Required three-letter uppercase IATA arrival airport code; no default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

currency.description: Three-letter uppercase currency code; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

departure_id.description: Required three-letter uppercase IATA departure airport code; no default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

gl.description: Two-letter country code; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

hl.description: Interface language code; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

outbound_date.description: Required outbound date in YYYY-MM-DD format; no default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

return_date.description: Return date in YYYY-MM-DD format, on or after outbound_date; optional. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

travel_class.description: Cabin class: 1 economy, 2 premium economy, 3 business, 4 first; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

type.description: Trip type: 1 round trip, 2 one way; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

name: search_flights
title: Google Flights
